ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mercury and Mars

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and friendships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and your career. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and intimacy. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
From {H:1802803107000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and relationships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.
